description: This file defines the 'Circle' class for drawing circle overlays on a map, extending 'CircleMarker'. It includes methods for setting radius, getting bounds, and projecting the circle on different coordinate reference systems.

classes.name: Circle
classes.description: A class for drawing circle overlays on a map, extending 'CircleMarker'.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor for the Circle class, initializes with latlng, options, and legacyOptions.

methods.name: setRadius
methods.description: Sets the radius of the circle in meters.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Returns the current radius of the circle in meters.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the LatLngBounds of the circle.

methods.name: _project
methods.description: Projects the circle onto the map, calculating pixel positions and radii based on the map's CRS.
